executive_summary: The infrastructure has a low risk posture with no immediate threats. The main concern is the underutilization of resources, which could indicate inefficiencies but does not pose an imminent danger.

predicted_failures.description: The server Vishnuu_GPU operates in an active-passive high availability mode, which could lead to service disruption if the passive node fails.

root_causes.description: The server Vishnuu_GPU is configured in an active-passive HA setup, which lacks redundancy if the passive node fails.

preventive_measures.action: Implement an active-active HA setup for Vishnuu_GPU to ensure redundancy.
preventive_measures.rationale: This will prevent service disruption if either node fails.
